original_owner: original canonical public website / Netlify build

root_cause.observed: Five user iPhone screenshots show blank white CTA, inconsistent mobile header, non-closing navigation, unreadable and non-draggable knowledge comparison, and reported unresponsive controls.
root_cause.cause: Multiple legacy/V18 header owners and overflow-x:hidden on html/body break sticky behavior in iOS; white-on-white secondary CTA after CSS collision; knowledge comparison input is below the visual frame rather than its touch target; close control depends on the header layer.

fix.scope: Single idempotent public CSS+JS layer injected at original final Netlify build, not portal; restores header/CTA/close and one native range for knowledge comparison.
non_goals: no false sitewide interaction success without real browser tests

prevention: Keep one public mobile header and menu authority; all sitewide changes pass through the canonical build
Test sticky after scroll on real mobile browser and menu open then close; never assert only aria-expanded open
Every visual slider must have one keyboard/touch native input as its actual hit target
Test computed button text/background contrast, including secondary CTAs and legacy CSS collisions
Keep production status EVIDENCE_DUE until protected checks, exact Netlify READY SHA and independent browser readback
Require actual keyboard/touch/mobile menu-close and sticky-header browser checks in the original protected website delivery lane, not only source-level regex or visibility checks

evidence.source: User-provided screenshots and original GitHub source; public URL https://www.bedrijfsgeheugen.nl
evidence.limitation: Source patch is not proof that all pages and all controls work. CI and browser checks remain required.

assertions: knowledge native range keyboard Home/End and pointer hit target

next_action: Protected Required/BRAIN/CodeQL and preview browser evidence, then protected merge and exact-main Netlify READY plus mobile production readback.
